== Biography ==
Eliza was born about 1846<ref>Based on age as recorded at death</ref> in County Antrim. Ireland. She was the daughter of Thomas Glasgow.

She and sister Rose emigrated to New Zealand on the ''Mermaid'', arriving at Lyttelton in December 1862.<ref>''Mermaid'' Passenger List [https://freepages.rootsweb.com/~nzbound/genealogy/mermaid.htm]</ref>

She married John Haigh in Christchurch on 12 January 1865.<ref>https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz - NZBDM - Marriage 1865/7148</ref>

They had children:
# [[Haigh-1638|Thomas Glasgow Haigh]] (1865-1954)
# [[Haigh-1639|John Haigh]] (1867-1954)
# [[Haigh-1495|Mary Jane Haigh]] (1869-1892)
# [[Haigh-1494|Ann Eliza Haigh]] (1871-1872)
# [[Haigh-1496|Emma (Haigh) Hughson]] (1872-1969)
# [[Haigh-645|Rose Ann (Haigh) Ormandy]] (1874-1963)
# [[Haigh-1640|Eliza (Haigh) Clarke]] (1876-1963)
# [[Haigh-1377|Joseph Haigh]] (1879-1937)
# [[Haigh-1641|Robert Alexander Haigh]] (1880-1966)


Eliza died on the 12 August 1934 at her home in 134 Ferry Road. <ref>New Zealand Births Deaths and Marriages Online, [https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/], Death registration for Eliza Haigh, age 88; 1934/15337 </ref><ref>Death Notice; ''Press'', 13 Aug 1934, pg 1 [https://paperspast.natlib.govt.nz/newspapers/CHP19340813.2.4]</ref>
She was buried on the 14 August in Plot 23, Block 32 at the Bromley Cemetery. <ref>National Library of New Zealand, ''Papers Past'', [https://paperspast.natlib.govt.nz/newspapers/CHP19340813.2.150.6?], ''Press'', 13 August 1934, page 21; Funeral notice for Eliza Haigh. </ref>Her husband John is interred in the adjoining grave of Plot 24, Block 32. <ref>Christchurch City Council Cemeteries Database, [http://heritage.christchurchcitylibraries.com/Cemeteries], Burial details for Eliza Haigh. </ref> <ref>https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/156366018/eliza-haig</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-987]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The father’s held Rasharkin Presbyterian baptism transcription names Thomas and Mary Ann for this child. The baptism and 1851 daughter agree; identification with New Zealand Eliza Haigh remains a separate later-life question.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect PRONI MIC1P/292 against Braswell’s transcription.

Source basis already held: [https://genealogy.torrens.org/BannValley/church/RasharkinP/Baptisms_1834.html Barbara Braswell, transcript of Rasharkin Presbyterian Church baptisms, Baptisms, 1834–1846 (https://genealogy.torrens.org/BannValley/church/RasharkinP/Baptisms_1834.html), entries 162, 199 and 269 (accessed 9 August 2026). This is a derivative transcription; the controlling original register is PRONI MIC1P/292.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
